description: Enhanced prose end-to-end cases: empty input (empty output), a fully correct sentence (empty output), an omitted lang field defaulting to prose handling, and several misspellings reported in order. Each misspelled word is reported as its UTF-8 start byte offset, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"spellcheck","text":<text>[,"lang":"text"]}.
